result.title: CodecMotion-OAD: Efficient Online Action Detection with Compressed-Domain Motion
result.summary: Online action detection (OAD) identifies ongoing actions in streaming videos. Many existing OAD systems combine RGB appearance with optical flow, but dense-flow extraction remains a major computational bottleneck. Codec motion vectors (MVs) are available during decoding, avoiding a separate optical-flow computation. On THUMOS'14, optical flow exceeds MVs by 11.2 mAP points with motion-only inputs, whereas the gap narrows to 3.7 points after RGB fusion, with the largest reduction in action-category discrimination. We propose CodecMotion-OAD, which replaces optical flow with decoder-provided MVs while retaining existing temporal detector architectures. Its two-stage training first aligns MV features with a pretrained flow-feature interface without action labels and then trains RGB+MV detectors using ground-truth labels and soft predictions from a frozen RGB+Flow teacher. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first application of codec MVs to frame-level OAD. On THUMOS'14 with MiniROAD, CodecMotion-OAD achieves 68.3 mAP versus 70.9 mAP for matched-distillation RGB+Flow, while reducing decoder-to-prediction processing time by 11.48-fold on CPU and 2.04-fold on GPU.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向流式视频的在线动作检测，提出用解码时可得的 codec 运动矢量替代光流，并以两阶段训练（先用无标签对齐到预训练光流特征接口，再用 RGB+Flow 教师软预测训练 RGB+MV 检测器），在 THUMOS'14 上以显著更低的处理耗时接近 RGB+Flow 精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 用廉价压缩域运动替代昂贵光流的特征对齐与教师蒸馏思路，可能为 LVR 中低成本视觉证据获取及「LOOK」收益/成本权衡提供线索；但任务与推理状态机制相距较远，需较多核查。
